about: Multi-timeframe candle scanner (bullets). Every candle pattern in live/candles.py is checked on every timeframe below the moment a candle of that timeframe closes, on every index and F&O stock (intraday timeframes from the live 1-minute candles, joined to yesterday's recorded ones; daily and weekly from the daily candles, finished days only). Every pattern found is recorded in the day's data (the 'candles' part of data/recordings) and added to each test-bench signal as facts (which way the latest candle on each timeframe points). bench: timeframes whose alertable patterns also get an honest paper test on the test bench in every style (kind candle_<pattern>, version = the timeframe). The existing 5-minute candle trials on the indices and first stocks keep running as they are; five_min_all_stocks records 5-minute patterns on every other stock too. forming: show how the candle that is still forming looks so far (information only: a candle is not a pattern until it closes). Nothing here sends an alert or touches the paper account: everything is on trial.
